workload.timing_scope: Synchronous host-call wall time: perf_counter_ns immediately before compiled invocation through detach().cpu().clone() for every returned tensor. Includes dispatch, input transfer, execution, output transfer and host copies. Guard, oracle, input construction, checks, persistent-state inspection, resets, compilation and report IO are outside the timer. A cycle is the sum of 16 separately timed calls with verification between calls. This is not device-only latency, uninterrupted throughput, TP2 or model speedup. A neutral wall-time result does not establish that the compiler already fuses the writer.
